dimensions.assessment: Involves the GAO, specific congressional committees, and three regional river basin commissions.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Government Accountability Office (GAO) to review and report on the ethics policies... of the Mid-Atlantic River Basin Commissions

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and oversight-focused review and reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: review the ethics policies and practices... identify duties and responsibilities... that may be duplicative

dimensions.assessment: Does not specify federal appropriations or economic impacts.
Mandates a one-time federal audit report and multi-year compliance reporting by specific regional entities.
dimensions.evidence: Comptroller General... shall initiate a review of the Mid-Atlantic River Basin Commissions

dimensions.assessment: Includes a one-year reporting deadline for GAO and a 5-year compliance plan requirement for the commissions.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter for five years, each commission must submit to Congress a plan

missing_information: Cost of conducting the GAO study
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the GAO to conduct a review of three Mid-Atlantic River Basin Commissions regarding ethics, communication, and funding, and requires subsequent compliance plans from the commissions.
